wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: TWO Schedule A pages, both gated separately and then together. p2: 15 rows = 100+200+200+100+1000+100+500+500+250+500+100+500+100+100+200 = 4450.00, equal to the printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 4450.-' (a trailing dash for no cents, per SS 3(g) = 4450.00). p3: 4 rows = 200+30+20+27,617.32 = 27,867.32, equal to the printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 27,867.32'. The two page subtotals sum to 4450.00+27867.32 = 32,317.32, which is the 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' printed identically on BOTH pages, and equals Box B (This Period) and Box C (Year-to-Date) on the Summary Page - equal to each other, so period and cumulative coincide; recorded cumulative per addendum SS C. Cache CFD prints no separate '$50.00 or less' aggregate line, so the le50 anchors do not exist (null, not zero). Box A is a slashed-zero glyph = 0 under SS 3(f).

expenditures.detail: ONE-CENT DELTA, ISOLATED TO SCHEDULE B PAGE 2 (p5), PUBLISHED VERBATIM AND NOT ADJUSTED. p4: 15 rows = 1579.79+1579.80+97.93+652.89+309.90+5425.21+672.46+42.74+4700.00+122.47+112.74+8795.50+525.33+1200.00+315.32 = 26,132.08, which GATES EXACTLY on the printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 26132.08'. p5: 7 rows = 3708.38+32.00+112.74+37.40+5.34+2176.63+112.74 = 6,185.23, against a printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 6185.24' - ONE CENT SHORT. Every p5 amount was re-read in a 600 dpi crop of the whole amount column and each read identically; no digit is in doubt, so no row was altered to close the page. Consequently the side's row total is 26132.08 + 6185.23 = 32,317.31 against the printed schedule total / Box D / Box E of 32,317.32. BOTH FIGURES ARE RETAINED; the residual is the FILER's arithmetic on the p5 page subtotal. needs_review=1 is set on every row of this side per the delta contract, with each row's note recording whether its own page gate closed. Boxes D and E carry identical content, so period and cumulative coincide; recorded cumulative. Cause traced on the page: p5 line 6 is the one line the filer revised - he wrote an amount, struck it through, and wrote 2176.63 above it; the 0.01 most plausibly rides on that revision, but that is an OBSERVATION, not a repair, and the struck figure was NOT substituted.

gates.page_subtotal: FOUR page gates run, three fire exact and one does not. p2 rows 4450.00 = printed 4450.- EXACT. p3 rows 27,867.32 = printed 27,867.32 EXACT. p4 rows 26,132.08 = printed 26132.08 EXACT. p5 rows 6,185.23 vs printed 6185.24 - WILL NOT GATE, one cent short after 600 dpi re-reads of all seven amounts; both figures named, no row adjusted. Report-level: contributions 4450.00+27867.32 = 32,317.32 = printed total EXACT; expenditures 26132.08+6185.23 = 32,317.31 vs printed total 32,317.32.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py on all four schedule pages returned geometry_status=ok with 15 bands each (deskew 0.2 / 0.3 / 0.5 / 1.2 deg). p2: bands 1-15 ALL inked => 15 rows. p3: bands 1-4 inked, 5-15 empty => 4 rows. p4: bands 1-15 ALL inked => 15 rows. p5: bands 1-7 inked, 8-15 empty => 7 rows. Totals 19 contribution rows and 22 expenditure rows. Band index maps 1:1 onto line_no within each page. Scored against INK as well as bands: on p2/p3 the filer writes the donor ADDRESS across two physical lines within one band, and both lines belong to one transaction - the second line is a wrapped street address carrying digits, which is exactly the SS 5 trap, so it was discarded at read time and never treated as a name or a separate row. On p4 line 9 the vendor text overruns into the Purpose column ('Cache Valley Media Group Radio ads'); split at the column rule, not by guesswork. Two page-full grids (p2, p4) are the case where a dropped row would still leave a plausible sum, so the per-page subtotals were used as the independent check and three of the four close exactly.
gates.geometry_proof: Run on all four schedule pages. p2: line_no=1 amount box renders '100', line_no=15 renders '200', control one row-pitch below renders the printed footer 'Subtotal for this page $ 4450.-' (the grid is full to its last line and the footer abuts it - reported as it is, not as a clean empty). p3: line_no=1 renders '200', line_no=4 renders '27,617.32', control one pitch below renders EMPTY. p4: line_no=1 renders '1579.79', line_no=15 renders '315.32', control renders the printed footer 'Subtotal for this page $ 26132...' (grid full, footer abuts). p5: line_no=1 renders '3708.38', line_no=7 renders '112.74', control one pitch below renders EMPTY. Geometry emitted in the un-rotated portrait frame poppler renders (1700x2200 px at 200 dpi).
gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY AGAINST THE FILER'S OWN STATED TOTALS. Box A (slashed zero = 0) + Box B 32,317.32 = Box F 32,317.32 (printed F = 32,317.32); Box F 32,317.32 - Box D 32,317.32 = 0 = printed 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period', a slashed-zero glyph = 0. Note WHY it closes so neatly and that this is the filer's construction, not an artefact: the last contribution line (p3 line 4, 10/31) is the candidate and his spouse self-funding 27,617.32, an amount that makes total contributions equal total expenditures to the cent and leaves a zero balance. The itemized expenditure rows fall 0.01 short of that stated total (see recon.expenditures); the chain above is computed from the STATED boxes, which is what the form prints, and nothing was recomputed from the rows. NO CROSS-FILING CHAIN AVAILABLE: this is the only Marc Ensign document in this chunk, so there is no sibling filing here whose cumulative column could be chained to it. Not attempted from any other filer's document.

escalation_note: 600 dpi amount-column band re-reads on all four schedule pages (p2 in two halves, p3, p4 in two halves, p5 whole); 450-600 dpi crops of all four page-subtotal cells and the report-total cells; a 600 dpi crop of the p3 line-2 amount; and 12 geometry-proof cell crops (first/last/control on each of p2, p3, p4, p5). THE DECISIVE ONE: at the 110 dpi contact-sheet pass the p3 line-2 amount read '50', which would have made the page sum 27,887.32 against a printed subtotal of 27,867.32. The 200 dpi render and then a 600 dpi tight crop both read '30', and 200+30+20+27,617.32 closes on the printed 27,867.32 exactly. Arithmetic and the escalated read agree; the contact sheet was wrong, which is precisely why it is never the transcription source.
notes: LARGEST FILING IN THIS CHUNK and entirely handwritten - 6 pages, TWO Schedule A pages (p2, p3) and TWO Schedule B pages (p4, p5), 19 contribution rows and 22 expenditure rows. All four schedule pages carry the same footer identity block 'Marc Ensign / 11/1/22 / Page n' for n = 2,3,4,5,6; pages 1-6 complete, ONE report (n_reports_in_pdf=1) - the extra pages are the form's own 'Attach additional pages as needed' continuation, not a second stapled report. || OFFICE LINE AGREES WITH THE CHUNK FILE: the p1 'Office' box reads, in the filer's hand, 'County Executive'; the chunk file / index.csv say 'County Executive'. In scope - a county office, not school board or municipal. || Type of Report marked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; 'Is this report an amendment?' answered No. Signature date 11/1/2022; Date of Report 11/1/22; clerk stamp 'CLERK/AUDITOR RCVD 2022 NOV 1 PM4:08'. || NO YEAR ON ANY SCHEDULE A DATE. Every one of the 19 contribution dates is written month/day only ('9/14', '10/27'), with no year anywhere in the cell. Under the per-row contract a cell with no year printed stays BLANK with needs_review=1 and the verbatim kept in the note, and the year is NEVER filled from the report date - so all 19 contribution rows carry a blank date. This is a large honest gap and it is the filer's, not the transcription's. The Schedule B dates on p4 DO carry two-digit years ('9-8-22') and parse; the seven p5 expenditure dates do NOT (two of them are ranges), so those seven are blank too. Net: 26 of the 41 rows have a blank date. || DATE RANGES ON p5: line 16 reads '9/15 - 10/18 2022' and line 21 reads '10/19-28' - two dates in one cell, which the contract makes BLANK + needs_review regardless of the year, with the verbatim in the note. || STRUCK-THROUGH AMOUNT, p5 line 6: the filer wrote an amount, scored it out with several strokes, and wrote '2176.63' above it. The struck figure is partly legible as something like '22..0.07' and is deliberately NOT transcribed - it is a cancelled value, not a field. Only the operative 2176.63 is emitted, and the struck glyphs are described rather than guessed at. || PRIVACY: this filing prints every donor's street address and ZIP in the clear on p2 and p3, on a SECOND physical line under the city; each of those continuation lines carries digits and is a street address, not a wrapped name (the SS 5 trap) - all discarded at read time. The candidate's own PO box, phone number and personal email on p1 were likewise discarded and appear nowhere in this record. Only donor_city / donor_state are emitted. || SELF-FUNDING: p3 line 4 is 'Marc + Heidi Ensign' for 27,617.32, 85% of all contributions reported. Addendum SS D says a candidate's own name in the donor column is normal; transcribed verbatim, no inference drawn beyond noting the balance construction above. || ZIP/CITY MISMATCH NOT CORRECTED: p2 line 14 gives the city as 'Logan' with ZIP [street address discarded at read time per PRIVACY.md] (a North Logan ZIP), while p2 line 6 writes 'North Logan' with the same [street address discarded at read time per PRIVACY.md]. donor_city is transcribed as the filer WROTE it in each case; no city was normalised from a ZIP. || No in-kind column exists on this form and the filer marked nothing in-kind, so in_kind is false on every row by construction, never inferred. || Field-shift screen: p2 has 15 dates, 15 names, 15 address blocks, 15 amounts; p3 4/4/4/4; p4 15 dates, 15 vendors, 15 purposes, 15 amounts; p5 7/7/7/7. Counts equal on every page, every date cell holds date-shaped content and no name cell holds a date. The one place columns genuinely blur is p4 line 9, handled above. No shift. || Minor metadata note: the chunk file records index_format 'text', but pdftotext returns no text layer (6 bytes) - the PDF is image-faced and was read as images.
